description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultThingsAggregatorConfig class, which implements the ThingsAggregatorConfig interface for configuring aspects of the Entities Aggregator in Eclipse Ditto's Concierge service. It includes configuration parameters such as timeout durations and parallelism levels, and provides methods for instantiation and standard object methods.

classes.name: DefaultThingsAggregatorConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ThingsAggregatorConfig, managing configuration for the Things Aggregator, including timeout and parallelism settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultThingsAggregatorConfig instance based on a provided Config, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getSingleRetrieveThingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for retrieving a single 'thing'.

methods.name: getMaxParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed parallelism for thing retrieval or processing.
